title: I made an annotator plugin for Unity, so you can point at anything in the editor and your AI agents can immediately understand it
author: either-15-or-40
selftext:
While working with Claude and Codex, I noticed that the annotator tool they had for websites was really useful. With the annotator, you could request edits for a specific element on a website.

I noticed the lack of tooling while working on my own projects in Unity, and decided to make something similar. 

With Annotator for Unity, you can pick gameobjects or editor controls, and add your own notes to it. 

The useful thing about it (and what makes it different than just taking screenshots manually yourself) is that you can batch all your notes together and send it as one request to your coding agent. 

There are some more details that makes it even more easy to use and useful but I'm gonna skip over them for this post.

Let me know if you have any questions or comments.
